jon: PR #489 (site/guides/migration-runtime.md) is blocked by a docs-preview failure and needs an engineering confirmation about runtime defaults (max_context_tokens + oversize handling). cc @priya for eng.
priya: Link?
jon: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489 — preview log shows: 'linkcheck: unresolved anchor /reference/runtime-config#defaults' and reviewers requested clarification on 'reject_oversize' semantics.
ci-bot: docs-preview failed 1: linkcheck error at migration-runtime.md: unresolved reference '/reference/runtime-config#defaults'
rachel: Who's the reviewer on this? It currently needs two approvals before merge. We also have a doc freeze window tomorrow 09:00-17:00 UTC, fyi.
sam: I'm assigned as reviewer. I can do content review but need the exact runtime defaults to avoid contradictions with the SDK migration snippet.
priya: Quick engineering answer:
- hosted default: max_context_tokens = 4096
- dedicated: per-deployment limit, defaults to 8192 if not specified
- private/on-prem: no enforced global default; node-level limit applies, typically 16384 in our standard package
- reject_oversize: server returns 413 for requests that exceed server-side hard limit; for hosted we set reject_oversize = true. Client SDKs may pre-check and raise a 400-ish client error if configured.
jon: Can you paste the canonical config snippet we should show in the migration guide? I want to update the example and the reference anchor.
priya: Paste below (feel free to inline in docs):
```
# runtime.defaults
max_context_tokens: 4096      # hosted default
reject_oversize: true         # server drops requests > limit
oversize_policy:
  soft_trim: true             # SDK can trim if enabled
  error_code: 413
```
Note: for dedicated add `deployment.runtime.max_context_tokens` override; for private mention admin-managed node limit.
jon: Excellent. Also, SDK migration snippet currently suggests client-side trimming is automatic. That's incorrect for Python SDK; it only warns by default. We'll need to change that text to show the explicit call-site trimming helper.
sam: Priya 1: what's the recommended error language to show in the docs when we return 413? Some users interpret 413 as client-only payload issues.
priya: Suggest adding: "413 Payload Too Large — the request exceeds the server's configured context window; reduce batch size, shorten prompts, or enable client-side trimming as shown below." That will be explicit.
jon: I'll update migration-runtime.md: move the runtime defaults into a reference section with anchor `#runtime-defaults` (so linkcheck can find it), fix the Python SDK snippet to show manual trimming helper, and add the 413 wording. Will push shortly.
docs-bot: Preview requested: https://deploy-preview-489--docs.redwood-inference.com 1: status: pending
ci-bot: Preview failed 1: linkcheck unresolved reference '/reference/runtime-config#defaults' at line 78
priya: Ah, our reference page is /reference/runtime-config and the anchor key is `#runtime-defaults` not `#defaults`. Use the correct anchor.
jon: Fixed anchor and pushed. Also added a short note for dedicated/private overrides and the error text.
docs-bot: Preview requested: https://deploy-preview-489--docs.redwood-inference.com 1: status: success :tada:
sam: Reviewing now. The SDK snippet looks good but please add a one-line caveat: "behavior may differ for streaming endpoints." Then I can approve.
jon: Added the caveat.
rachel: Quick governance note: because this is user-facing config documentation and the freeze window starts tomorrow, we need an on-call release exemption to merge after 17:00 UTC. If you want it out before freeze, we need it merged and cut by 08:30 UTC tomorrow. Otherwise we'll approve and schedule a post-freeze merge.
jon: We need this in the early deploy, it's part of the migration path for a partner customer. Can someone from product/channels approve the hotfix? @rachel can you coordinate?
rachel: I'll raise the exemption with PMs. If Sam approves content now and Priya is ok with the text, I'll sign off for schedule.
sam: Approved from my side. :+1:
priya: Confirmed the text matches server behaviour. Fine to merge.
rachel: OK noted. I filed the exemption and will merge during the morning cut window. Jon ping me if anything else changes.
jon: Thanks everyone, merging after CI green."
